exports.signature: pub fn compile(pattern: &str, max_states: u32, max_steps: u32) -> Result<PatternProgram>
exports.description: Iterative Unicode-scalar Thompson compiler with fallible allocation, linked patch lists, source-order emission, canonical merged classes, explicit syntax errors, inclusive state limits, and one final Accept. Empty expressions emit a Jump followed by their continuation. Parser storage is bounded by the checked u32 source byte length.

exports.signature: pub fn validate(program: &PatternProgram, max_states: u32) -> Result<()>
exports.description: Validates version, positive execution allowance, instruction count, start, every outgoing target, Unicode scalars, canonical ranges, and structural Accept reachability. Checks unreachable instructions and permits epsilon cycles and empty classes.

exports.signature: pub fn is_match(program: &PatternProgram, text: &str, steps_left: &mut u64) -> Result<bool>
exports.description: Validates the entire raw program before execution, then performs unanchored scalar-boundary search using generation-marked closures. Charges local and caller allowances for start injections, instruction visits, transition tests, and class-search comparisons. Preserves caller budget across invocations and propagates exhaustion as BudgetExhausted.

integration_notes: Structural raw-program validation precedes execution metering so malformed unreachable instructions cannot be hidden by an early match or exhausted caller budget.
Empty expressions have an explicit Jump; the completely empty compiled pattern therefore occupies two instructions including Accept.
Empty positive classes match no scalar; empty negated classes match every valid scalar.
Lazy and possessive postfix pairs produce UnsupportedSchemaFeature; other repeated postfix forms produce ConstraintViolation.
No unsafe code, prohibited commands, dependency edits, root-module edits, or other worker-file edits were used.
